note: A ring counts only for people whose full-time job is the football program. These patterns (matched case-insensitively against the role text as the source words it) mark rows as external: people who are around the team but employed by someone else. Each rule carries the reason shown in the site's methodology note.

external.label: Law enforcement
external.reason: State troopers and team security are sworn officers on assignment, employed by their agency, not the school.

external.label: Chaplains & ministry
external.reason: Team chaplains and FCA staff are employed by a ministry or the Fellowship of Christian Athletes, not the athletics department.

external.label: Consulting physicians
external.reason: Team physicians, surgeons, dentists and radiologists practice medicine elsewhere and cover the team; the athletic trainers who work for the program full time are still counted.

external.label: Volunteer
external.reason: Volunteer coaches are unpaid and not on the program's payroll.

keepOverrides.reason: An athletics-department directorship, held by an M.D. but a full-time department job.
Full-time athletic medicine staff working for the department.
